vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit many times; to win against someone
to confuse; a problem that is hard to understand

vocabulary.example: The view from the hill is amazing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very informal words used by a group of people
a fastener on clothes and bags; to close it
vocabulary.example: Zip up your coat, it's cold.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the top outside part of a building
vocabulary.example: We watched the fireworks from the rooftop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell people something officially or publicly
when two things happen together by chance
vocabulary.example: What a coincidence - we have the same birthday!

vocabulary.meaning_en: the top cover of a pot or box
vocabulary.example: Put the lid on the pan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep something at the right level; to make it do what you want

vocabulary.example: Thank you for the lovely present.
What's the reason for the delay?

fine_lines.title: Zip it vs keep a lid on it
fine_lines.explanation_ar: zip it طريقة وقحة وقوية لتقول لشخص أن يسكت الآن. keep a lid on it لها معنيان: أن تُبقي شيئاً سراً، أو أن تتحكم في شيء (مشاعر، مصاريف) كي لا يزيد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Zip it!' is a rude, strong way to tell someone to be quiet now. 'Keep a lid on it' means to keep something secret, or to control something (feelings, costs) so it doesn't grow.

examples.sentence: Zip it! I'm trying to listen.
The surprise party is tomorrow - keep a lid on it!

fine_lines.title: Keep a lid on it vs shout it from the rooftops
fine_lines.explanation_ar: تعبيران متعاكسان: keep a lid on it تعني اكتم الخبر، و shout it from the rooftops تعني أخبر الجميع بفخر وسعادة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Opposites: 'keep a lid on it' = keep the news secret; 'shout it from the rooftops' = tell everyone happily.

examples.sentence: Keep a lid on the news until it's official.
I passed my driving test - I want to shout it from the rooftops!

expressions.meaning_en: I don't know or understand it
expressions.example: It beats me why the bus is always late.

expressions.meaning_en: (slang) it's excellent, especially music, food or a film
expressions.example: Have you tried this new burger place? It slaps!

expressions.meaning_en: a rude way to tell someone to stop talking
to tell everyone about something because you are happy or proud
expressions.example: She got the scholarship and wanted to shout it from the rooftops.

expressions.meaning_en: said when you meet someone you know in a place you didn't expect, or find a surprising connection
expressions.example: My new neighbour went to my school - it's a small world!

expressions.meaning_en: to keep something secret, or to control something so it doesn't get worse
expressions.example: Prices are rising, so I'm trying to keep a lid on my spending.

expressions.meaning_en: the kind idea behind a present matters more than the present itself
expressions.example: The scarf is the wrong colour, but it's the thought that counts.

expressions.meaning_ar: هذا الشيء تحديداً هو ما يعجبني/يزعجني
expressions.meaning_en: (slang) used to name the exact thing you love or dislike about something
expressions.example: I love this café. It's the fresh bread for me!

grammar.title: 'It' as a dummy subject
grammar.explanation_ar: في كثير من التعابير لا تشير it إلى شيء محدد، بل هي فاعل شكلي: It beats me, It's a small world. كذلك في تعبير It's the ... for me نضع بعد the الشيء الذي نقصده.
grammar.explanation_en: In many expressions 'it' doesn't point to a clear thing - it's an empty (dummy) subject: 'It beats me', 'It's a small world'. In 'It's the ... for me', we put the exact thing after 'the'.
examples: It beats me how he did it.
